entries.note: Huaxin takes the shipper's order; its text asks to wait. The goods are not with Huaxin yet.
A dispatcher sends a vehicle to collect the goods, which are not with Huaxin yet. The text names the dispatcher and gives no status, so the node's name is shown.
The goods are collected from the shipper.
The status reads 已从提货仓库离场: the vehicle leaves the shipper's warehouse with the goods.
Taken into Huaxin's warehouse minutes after leaving the shipper's, so the goods are already on their way.
Sent on from Huaxin's warehouse towards the destination.
The status names the Huaxin warehouses the goods pass: sent from one to another, then arrived at a transfer point.
Given half an hour before 运抵 and the signature on the same day in the destination district.

entries.english: Arrived at the consignee, awaiting signature
entries.note: The status reads 已运抵收货单位待签收: the goods have reached the receiving business and wait for its signature, the next node.
The consignee signs for the goods. The node names the operator and the signer, which the adapter leaves out.
